_about: laneFIXSAVE v1: RunMode.cs. Command-line flags that mark a proof / capture / QA run for SAVE SAFETY only (LootSave refuses to write the real loot_save.json under any of them unless -savePath is given). flags = exact match, prefixes = starts-with, both case-insensitive. Add new harness flags here. This is a superset of menu.json harnessArgs and GameLoop.HarnessOn (those are still ORed in by code); -zones alone is normal play and is NOT listed.
